patterns.note: A multi-column layout is used, featuring a prominent main content area, a left-aligned 'Latest' section, and a sticky right sidebar for related content.

Headings use a clean sans-serif font, with the hero section employing a very large, bold variant, while article titles are medium-large and body text is standard, creating a clear typographic hierarchy.
The site primarily uses a clean white background with dark text, accented by a brand palette derived from the multi-colored logo, which includes green, yellow, and pink/purple.

As the user scrolls down, the main header shrinks in height and becomes sticky at the top of the viewport, while a content block in the right sidebar also becomes sticky, maintaining its position as the main content scrolls beneath it.
Content is organized into a prominent hero section, followed by a grid of article cards, and a distinct 'OUR VISION' section with a full-width background image and centered text.

technique_notes: The main header uses JavaScript to detect scroll depth, triggering a class change that reduces its height and applies a fixed position to make it sticky. The right sidebar content block utilizes CSS position: sticky to remain visible at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls past the main content. Article listings are arranged in a responsive grid layout, likely using CSS Grid or Flexbox, ensuring content adapts across various screen sizes. The hero section features a large background image with text overlaid, using text shadows or a subtle gradient overlay to ensure readability against the image.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif hero text (~4x body) with medium-large, bold article titles and small, light metadata labels.
design_tokens.radius: subtle rounded corners on images and card elements, maintaining a soft but not overly rounded aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced density with airy sections for the hero and 'OUR VISION' blocks, contrasting with a tighter, well-defined grid for article listings.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its effective use of a multi-column layout that integrates sticky elements, such as the shrinking header and a persistent right sidebar, to enhance navigation and content discoverability. This approach, combined with a visually rich hero section, creates an engaging and highly functional content browsing experience that feels editorial yet dynamic.
